summary.business_type: Open-source developer tool (product marketing + documentation publisher hybrid)
summary.data_notes: Performance is lab-only (Lighthouse local, mobile): PSI keyless quota exhausted and CrUX requires an API key; domain likely too new for field data. Backlinks via Common Crawl web graph only (no Moz/Bing credentials).
top_findings: No XML sitemap (/sitemap.xml -> 404) while domain is absent from Common Crawl web graph (in_crawl: false)
Zero JSON-LD structured data on all 11 pages (no SoftwareApplication, Organization, BreadcrumbList, TechArticle)
Identical meta description on all 11 pages
No Open Graph or Twitter Card meta tags sitewide
Flagship doc /docs/getting-started weighs 1.83MB: two GIFs (989KB + 680KB), TBT 2470ms, Lighthouse perf 0.66
quick_wins: Static /sitemap.xml + Sitemap directive in robots.txt + GSC submission
Self-referencing canonical tags in base layout

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt allows all; no noindex anywhere; all 11 routes return 200
Proper 404 status for missing pages; /admin correctly redirects to /login
Brotli compression, HTTP/2 + HTTP/3 via Cloudflare, server-rendered HTML, zero console errors

findings.title: No XML sitemap
findings.description: /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml return 404; robots.txt has no Sitemap directive; domain absent from Common Crawl web graph, so a sitemap is the primary discovery channel.
findings.recommendation: Generate /sitemap.xml for the 11 routes, add Sitemap directive to robots.txt, submit to GSC and Bing WMT.

findings.title: Missing HSTS
findings.description: No Strict-Transport-Security header on any response.
findings.recommendation: Enable HSTS max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains at the Cloudflare edge.

findings.title: Missing CSP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Baseline headers present (X-Frame-Options, nosniff, XSS) but no Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add report-only CSP then enforce; add Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin and minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.title: Short cache lifetime on fingerprinted assets
findings.description: Vite content-hashed /build/ assets served with max-age=14400 (4h).

findings.title: HTML never edge-cached
findings.description: cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC and cache-control: no-cache, private on every page (Laravel session/XSRF cookies on anonymous views).
findings.recommendation: Avoid starting sessions for anonymous marketing/docs GETs, then enable edge caching.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Substantial docs corpus: getting-started 5137 words, commands 3428 words
Human-written, non-duplicated body content, appropriate technical readability
Coherent docs information architecture with strong internal linking

findings.title: No trust/footer pages
findings.description: No About, License, Privacy, or Contact pages; weakens E-E-A-T trust evaluation next to a monetization page (/advertise).
findings.recommendation: Add footer links: About/Maintainer, License (MIT), Privacy, Contact.

findings.title: No authorship or freshness signals on docs
findings.description: Docs pages carry no author and no datePublished/dateModified.
findings.recommendation: Surface Last updated (from repo mtime) and maintainer attribution per doc.

findings.title: Thin docs hub
findings.recommendation: Add 200-400 words framing the documentation above the link list.

findings.title: No non-brand content surface
findings.description: Corpus targets only brand/product queries; no blog, changelog, or use-case pages.
findings.recommendation: Add changelog + 2-3 problem-aware articles targeting category queries (Phase 3).

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, well-formed titles on all pages (20-47 chars)
Exactly one h1 per page; no skipped heading levels
100% image alt coverage (15/15); no orphan pages

findings.title: Identical meta description on all 11 pages
findings.description: Every page serves the same 107-char description; Google will rewrite or ignore it, costing SERP CTR.
findings.recommendation: Per-page descriptions in Blade templates; derive docs descriptions from markdown intro or frontmatter.

findings.title: No Open Graph / Twitter Card tags
findings.description: Zero og:/twitter: tags sitewide; shared links render as bare URLs in the channels where a CLI dev tool spreads.
findings.recommendation: Add og:title/description/type/url/image + twitter:card summary_large_image with a 1200x630 OG image.

findings.title: No canonical tags
findings.description: No link rel=canonical on any page; docs content also lives in the GitHub repo, creating duplicate-content ambiguity risk.
findings.recommendation: Emit self-referencing canonicals in the base layout.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: No invalid markup (none exists to be wrong)

findings.title: Zero structured data sitewide
findings.description: 0 JSON-LD blocks on all 11 pages; no SoftwareApplication, WebSite, Organization, BreadcrumbList, or TechArticle; entity ambiguous vs. the Kimi assistant brand.
findings.recommendation: Ship JSON-LD @graph: SoftwareApplication+WebSite+Organization on home; TechArticle+BreadcrumbList on docs. Do NOT use HowTo (deprecated) or FAQPage (rich results retired 2026-05-07).

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: 10/11 routes at 0.95-1.00 mobile Lighthouse performance; CLS 0 everywhere
No render-blocking resources, no unused JS, HTTP/2+h3, Brotli

findings.title: Flagship doc is the slowest page
findings.description: /docs/getting-started: 1.83MB total, two animated GIFs (989KB + 680KB), TBT 2470ms, LCP 2.2s, perf 0.66. Lab data only (PSI/CrUX unavailable).
findings.recommendation: Replace GIFs with muted looping <video> (mp4/webm) or WebP posters; add srcset/sizes (796KiB flagged savings).

findings.title: No field CWV data
findings.description: CrUX/PSI require API key; domain likely too new for field data.
findings.recommendation: Configure Google API key and re-run pagespeed_check.py + crux_history.py.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) fully allowed via robots.txt
Semantic server-rendered HTML with extractable, self-contained doc sections

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with product one-liner, docs map, repo URLs, license.

findings.title: No entity disambiguation for AI engines
findings.description: No Organization/SoftwareApplication schema; product name collides with the Kimi assistant brand; no dates/authorship; zero third-party corroboration.
findings.recommendation: Ship the JSON-LD entity layer (shared with schema fix) + sameAs GitHub links + visible repo stats.

findings.title: Oversized animated GIFs on flagship doc
findings.recommendation: Convert to mp4/webm video or WebP posters.

findings.title: No responsive images or modern formats
findings.description: Lighthouse flags 796KiB responsive-image savings and 48KiB modern-format savings; no srcset, PNG/GIF only.
findings.recommendation: Generate width variants with srcset/sizes; convert statics to WebP.

phases.name: Phase 1: Discovery & Entity
items: Create /sitemap.xml + Sitemap directive in robots.txt + submit to GSC/Bing

phases.name: Phase 2: Experience & Trust
items: Replace GIFs on getting-started with video/WebP posters
Trust pages: About, License, Privacy, Contact in footer
Last-updated dates + maintainer attribution on docs
Expand /docs hub with 200-400 words of framing copy
a11y fixes: logo aria-label, ad-link contrast

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: 2-3 problem-aware pages targeting non-brand category queries
Link acquisition: awesome-lists, dev.to/Show HN/Reddit, directories, community

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Configure Google API key; re-run PSI + CrUX for field CWV
Configure free Moz API; track DA/referring domains monthly
Drift compare after each template-touching deploy
